utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Laguna Hills' by name among the cities in its service area. IMPORTANT CAVEAT confirmed via a separate search this session: like neighboring Laguna Niguel, Laguna Hills is split between SCE and San Diego Gas & Electric (SDG&E) territory, with the boundary running along Laguna Hills Drive. This record covers the SCE-served portion of the city only. Confidence reduced from the usual 0.9 to reflect this genuine split-territory complexity.

generation_supplier.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the CCA operating in Orange County, currently names Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley as members — Laguna Hills was not named among current members this session. Left null rather than asserted either way.

county.notes: Laguna Hills is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Laguna Hills Building/Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — applies only to the SCE-served portion of Laguna Hills; SDG&E-served residents would use SDG&E's own NEM program instead, which was not researched for this city this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its own distribution territory, which includes the SCE-served portion of Laguna Hills/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact — applies to the SCE-served portion of the city only.

value.name: SolarAPP+ inspection checklist plus the city-issued permit (must be on-site during inspection)

value: Schedule inspections via the City's Self-Service Permit Portal or an inspection request form

value.notes: Per the city's own page: once the online application is complete and fees are paid, 'the permit will be issued instantly.'

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ via City Self-Service Permit Portal
other_conditions: Covers most residential roof-top solar projects with or without an energy storage system
